"Issues")[![GitHub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crystal-nest/mod-fancy-assets/main/github/github.svg "GitHub")](https://github.com/crystal-nest/pyrotechnic-elytra/issues) --- ## **简介** 无论飞到哪里，都为众人呈现一场烟花盛宴！ 现在可以使用任意颜色、效果或形状的烟花火箭来为你的飞行提供助推力！ ![日间飞行](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crystal-nest/mod-fancy-assets/main/pyrotechnic-elytra/day-flight.gif "Pyrotechnic Day Flight") ![夜间飞行](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crystal-nest/mod-fancy-assets/main/pyrotechnic-elytra/night-flight.gif "Pyrotechnic Night Flight") ## **依赖项** | Mod | Loader | Requirement | |:----------------------------------------------------------------------|:------:|:-----------:| | [Cobweb](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobweb) | All | Required | ## **许可与使用条款** 欢迎将此模组模板用于任何模组，只需注明出处并附上[此链接](https://github.com/crystal-nest/pyrotechnic-elytra#readme)。 本项目采用[水晶巢社区许可证 v1](https://github.com/crystal-nest/pyrotechnic-elytra/blob/master/LICENSE)发布。 ## **支持我们**
